source: a 3d racing game where you race against the computer. dont ask for input just build the game

image_prompt.text: A wide standardized starting grid of evenly spaced slots so the player and the computer racers launch side by side without colliding
Guardrails along the circuit that physically block a car leaving the route
Curved track elements forcing clean direction reversals to carry the racer into the next lap
Computer-controlled opponent vehicles on the grid alongside the player

layout_placement.text: The evenly spaced launch slots on the starting grid
Detection regions at the start line and key intervals for lap counting and split times

notes: The user explicitly said not to ask for input, so theme and track character were assumed rather than queried; the assumptions are listed as open questions for a human but must not be put back to this user.
A lap circuit was assumed - the prompt says racing game but never says lap or point-to-point.

coverage_missing.ask: What should the track and surroundings look like - city streets, countryside, futuristic? (The user barred this question, so it was assumed instead.)
Laps around a circuit, or a point-to-point course? (Barred by the prompt; circuit assumed.)
How many laps, and how many computer opponents? (Barred by the prompt.)
